# Arizona Pigeon Proofing

> Solar panel pigeon proofing and cleaning for Arizona homeowners, fulfilled by local crews. Currently live in Tucson Metro, AZ; Phoenix Metro and the rest of Arizona are built but not yet fulfilled by a confirmed local crew.

Arizona Pigeon Proofing connects homeowners with local, vetted crews for two services: bird mesh/deterrent installation for solar panel arrays ("pigeon proofing"), and deionized-water solar panel cleaning. Leads are routed to a confirmed local vendor per metro area; the site itself does not perform the work.

## Services

- [Pigeon Proofing for Solar Panels](https://arizonapigeonproofing.com/pigeon-proofing-solar-panels/): stainless mesh installation, existing-nest removal, HOA-compliant installs.
- [Solar Panel Cleaning](https://arizonapigeonproofing.com/solar-panel-cleaning/): deionized-water washes scheduled around Arizona's dust and monsoon season.

## Locations

- [Tucson Metro](https://arizonapigeonproofing.com/locations/tucson-metro/) — live now: Tucson, Oro Valley, Marana, Sahuarita, Green Valley, Vail, Catalina Foothills.
- Phoenix Metro — pages built, awaiting a confirmed local vendor.
- Rest of Arizona — not yet available.

## Get a quote

- [Request a free quote](https://arizonapigeonproofing.com/quote/): name, phone, metro area, city, and service needed. Local crews follow up within 24–48 hours.
